title: KinderCare Commends Recent State Investments in Child Care
summary: California, Michigan, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Virginia all make strides toward increasing family access to high-quality early childhood education and care Key takeaways: KinderCare applauds California, Michigan, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Virginia for prioritizing early childhood education and care in their latest budgets. KinderCare helps deliver publicly funded early learning programs through its programs in these states, making high-quality child care more accessible to working families. Each state’s investments in child care assistance and early learning programs will help thousands of children access high-quality education and care. KinderCare supports policies that increase child care affordability, strengthen workforce participation and expand access to high-quality early childhood education.
